lines: 1. Getsemani pikuan khou jisu rui kalum bam khou,
Meiguai guang kariuna poubaomei ta nim the;
Karu khou tei lat nzan thai mak na
Kandih guang daimei rui thei khang salou e.
Rianra mei muang zing ]2
Kalvary chingru khou Poubaomei ta su luai;
Sao pirun le siang lou pui thing ru khou,
Dup loupui bam thai makge Poubaomei rui.
2. He! Simon Peter le latdiu lungh rianra guai thau o,
Poubaomei ta zai the thei nipui bam tangh khang;
Kandi khou keimei tingkao Guangh daihmei,
Rianra bam khou nkhalou nimei makge.
3. Tingkao lev kandih khou gaipui latcham lou meipu ta;
Suluai nina cho nangniu zion naa guai le;
Kamei gaipui tingmik tei muna cho?
Nangniu ringpui tuang e, nangniu ringkhang e,
4. He! Seraphim guai le tingkao latdiu nun guai zaulo.
Nkhalou mei makna rianramei guangh jisu .
Meinun guai paap phung na rianra bamkhou,
Kalungh ryanra na kaputa kaubam e.
5. Zao ngam makge pou rui Jordan duipaeng
Kanpat nimei, kazaeng mak na kapi ,
bumkeilou kan ding the,
Paap lev rihta ngam na Jordan duikan the.
Poubaomei ta zai the thei pui bam tangkhang.
